items.q: What is fleet maintenance management software?
items.a: A platform that centralizes each boat's maintenance history, schedules upcoming maintenance by calendar or hour thresholds, and alerts before critical operations become overdue.

items.q: My boats don't have connected sensors. Does it still work?
items.a: Yes. FleetAi is designed for manual entry of engine hours.

items.q: Can I migrate from another tool?
items.a: Yes — we import Excel, Google Sheets, Airtable and CSV/PDF exports from your existing tools.

items.q: How many users can I add?
items.a: Starter: 1 user. Pro: up to 5 users. Enterprise: unlimited. You pay per organization, not per seat.

items.q: Is the Starter plan really free?
items.a: Yes, free forever: up to 2 boats, 1 user, unlimited history. No credit card, no deadline. You can move to Pro or Enterprise any time from your settings, and back to Starter without losing your data.

items.q: How much does FleetAi cost for 15 boats?
items.a: The Pro plan covers up to 8 boats for €20/month (€16/month billed annually). Beyond that you add extra boats at €4/boat/month: 15 boats comes to €48/month on Pro. The Enterprise plan (€99/month) lifts the boat limit entirely. No hidden fees.
No. Monthly or annual, you can cancel any time in 1 click from your account. Annual simply offers −20% in exchange for a yearly commitment.
You keep access until the end of the paid period. Then you move to the free Starter plan for 90 days to export your data.
In the European Union (OVHcloud, Strasbourg), with no transfer outside the EU. Everything is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256).
Yes: dedicated DPO, deletion of your data on request within 30 days, daily backups kept for 30 days.

items.q: Is my data kept if I cancel my subscription?
items.a: For 90 days after cancellation, you can export to CSV/PDF. After that, permanent deletion (GDPR).

items.q: Does the AI see other customers' data?
items.a: No. Each organization is isolated. The AI only sees your data.
